label: a-right-v1
prompt: Use this attached 12-pose 4-column by 3-row right-facing Solid Snake atlas only as a pose/layout and identity-colour guide. Create a TRUE ORIGINAL METAL GEAR MACHINE FORM inspired by THIS MGS1 Solid Snake, not a cyborg man in armour. Replace every human body with the SAME compact fully mechanical 3.4-metre stealth combat walker design in the corresponding twelve poses: a broad angular navy/anthracite armoured central hull with integrated blue-black cockpit canopy, steel-blue side shoulder sensor/radiator pods and short powerful manipulator arms ending in industrial articulated clamps; clearly hydraulic backward-articulated walker knees and wide stable armoured mechanical feet; exposed joint bearings, pistons, actuator linkages and cables, and compact utilitarian modular supply/weapon cases placed like his original belt pouches. The head is a completely inhuman low angular sensor turret merged into the central hull, with a horizontal dark-navy optical visor reminiscent of Snake's bandana, two navy flexible sensor pennants trailing from the rear like his signature bandana tails, and a small rust-brown segmented turret crown that abstractly recalls his brown hair. NO human face, skin, hair, neck, cloth trousers, normal boots or human hand; NO generic REX copy, Ray copy, Iron Man, Raiden or Gray Fox body. The colour palette, dark tactical hull layout, navy visor/pennants, brown turret crown and pragmatic infiltration-machine personality should make the design recognizably a Metal Gear created from Solid Snake's appearance. Use wide unmistakably mechanical pelvis/torso geometry and hard-surface articulated joints instead of anatomically shaped muscle armour. Preserve the overall action poses and locomotion timing of each source silhouette as mechanically credible equivalents: row1 four idle-ready frames, row2 four walking step phases, row3 four guard/manipulator defence phases. All face RIGHT. Twelve full isolated walkers in identical consistent design, fixed believable standing scale, complete silhouettes, no clipped feet or part, clean transparent gaps at least 12 pixels between figures, no figure overlap. Keep positions close to source so every action pose can be mapped. Highly detailed native 2.5D fighting-game sprites with painterly steel material shading, sharp readable outer silhouette, consistent lighting. Fully transparent RGBA empty space, no scenery, no ground, no text or borders, no diagrams. This is an original personalised machine-costume concept, not a released canonical Metal Gear or an attested Snake incarnation.
